states.description: The AI generation process is the core domain logic of this page. It sends a structured prompt containing the spec's assertion data, the page's registered UI elements, and an audience context to the /ai/prompt endpoint. The output must conform to the ProductTour schema and meet specific quality criteria. These assertions define what 'correct' AI output looks like.

description: The Product Tours page (TourCatalog) enables users to generate AI-powered interactive product tours from existing UI Bridge page specs. Users select one or more page specs, choose a target audience (new user, power user, or evaluator), then trigger AI generation via the runner's /ai/prompt endpoint. Generated tours are previewed as TourCard components before being persisted to instanceStorage. Saved tours are cataloged by audience category and can be played back with the floating TourPlayer modal, or exported as JSON, Markdown, or HTML. The page implements a multi-phase generation workflow: idle → generating → previewing → done (or error on failure). Tour steps reference registered UI elements by ID and can execute demo actions (click, type, select, navigate) that the player performs automatically.
